story.value: Founded in 2001 under Adam. Douglas delivered the franchise's first championships (2017 and 2020) and continues to lead today.

Founded in 2001, this franchise has been steered by Brian Clark from its very first season. In 25 seasons, Brian Clark has built an enduring legacy: 4 championships (2009, 2010, 2016, and 2018), 16 playoff appearances, and a presence that defines the standard in this league.
Founded in 2001 under Byron. Dominic delivered the franchise's first championships (2007, 2008, 2011, 2021, and 2023) and continues to lead today.

Founded in 2001 under Dale. Joe Tyszko transformed the franchise into a perennial playoff contender, qualifying 6 times across 7 seasons. Nick Blaettler extended that run even further, reaching the postseason 10 times in 11 seasons — yet the title remained out of reach. Bryan Kearney finally delivered the championship this franchise had been building toward, winning in 2022. Today the franchise continues under Eric.
Founded in 2001 under Dan. Evan delivered the franchise's first championships (2012 and 2013) and continues to lead today.

Founded in 2001, this franchise has been steered by Fadi from its very first season. In 25 seasons, Fadi has built an enduring legacy: 1 championship (2024), 16 playoff appearances, and a presence that defines the standard in this league.

Founded in 2001 under Jamie. Jamie launched the franchise with immediate success, winning in 2001, 2002, 2003, and 2004. Mike contributed 4 seasons and a 31-21 regular season record to the franchise's history. Under Robby, the franchise reached the postseason 5 times in 6 seasons, though a title remained elusive. Today the franchise continues under Jeff.

Founded in 2001 under Rob. The early years under Rob built a competitive foundation with 5 playoff appearances across 6 seasons. Steve Swanson delivered the franchise's first championship (2019) and continues to lead today.

Founded in 2001, this franchise has been managed by Shawn throughout its entire existence. Shawn has kept the franchise in playoff contention with 16 postseason appearances across 25 seasons, compiling a 173-160 regular season record. The franchise's first title remains the next chapter yet to be written.

Founded in 2002, this franchise has been steered by Kevin O'Boyle from its very first season. In 24 seasons, Kevin O'Boyle has built an enduring legacy: 2 championships (2005 and 2015), 15 playoff appearances, and a presence that defines the standard in this league.

Founded in 2002, this franchise has been steered by Kevin Swanson from its very first season. In 24 seasons, Kevin Swanson has built an enduring legacy: 1 championship (2006), 18 playoff appearances, and a presence that defines the standard in this league.

Founded in 2003, this franchise has been steered by Thomas from its very first season. In 23 seasons, Thomas has built an enduring legacy: 2 championships (2014 and 2025), 13 playoff appearances, and a presence that defines the standard in this league.
